What your child will take into a changing workplace

AI is changing every job. Students learn to build the chips, devices, machines and software AI depends on, and to check the work they do with AI tools.

The programme is designed around eight working projects, an individual skills record and 16–20 weeks of final-semester engineering work. Ask to see the workshop and sample builds during a campus visit.

For those who want the detail

For each campus, ask for the awarding university, the exact degree title, the relevant approvals and written details on fees, eligibility, scholarships and facilities. The admissions team can confirm the details for the course you are considering.

Students can track their progress through each practical test they pass. The Engineering Passport records those skills individually.

See how students learn

Common questions

Will AI take my child’s job?

AI is changing what people do at work. The programme teaches students to build the chips, devices, machines and software AI depends on, and to use AI tools while checking their results.

Is computer science the right choice?

It depends on what your child wants to build. The CSE pathway focuses on AI software. The other engineering pathways apply computing to chips, electronics and machines.

What degree will my child receive?

The engineering programmes are designed as four-year B.Tech degrees. Ask admissions to confirm the awarding university, exact degree title and approvals for your chosen course and campus.

Can my child study further?

B.Tech graduates may apply to M.Tech, MS or MBA programmes, depending on the eligibility and admission requirements of the institution they apply to.

My child has never built anything. Can they manage?

The programme starts with the basics. A beginners’ bootcamp, personal kit, core project level and re-tests help students with different levels of experience make progress.

What if my child does not get an internship?

The Product Studio is the planned on-campus route for final-semester engineering work. It is designed around company problems and the same academic credit as the internship route.

What if my child wants to start a business?

The founder path helps students test ideas and build a pilot. Whether startup work can count towards final-semester credit depends on the university’s academic regulations.

Do you guarantee placement?

No. Employers make their own hiring decisions. The programme gives students practical experience and evidence of their skills to show employers. Super Engineering has yet to report graduate placement results.

What does it cost? Is there a hostel?

Ask admissions for confirmed fees, scholarship information and the hostel, transport and campus safety arrangements for the location you are considering.
